description.en: Spinning gradient loading indicator and conic ring spinner for modern React.
description.zh: 采用圆锥渐变流光与多重光晕的现代 React 旋转加载指示器组件。

content.en: Gradient Spin is a modern, GPU-optimized loading indicator component for React. Utilizing CSS conic gradients, smooth keyframe rotation, and soft ambient blur masks, it replaces default monochrome spinners with a fluid, luminous orbital animation.
content.zh: Gradient Spin 是一款采用现代 CSS 圆锥渐变（Conic Gradient）与微光模糊滤镜的高颜值 React 加载指示器。它摒弃了传统单色旋转菊花的沉闷，利用流动的光谱渐变与环境辉光，为界面的数据等待过程带来极富现代科技感的动态美学体验。
